description: States of each canvas screen the real app must reproduce. Each state has a fixture in e2e/fixtures/states/registry.ts and is captured by e2e/design/D-06-states.e2e.ts. A screen whose feature is not built yet is listed with `pending` (the change that adds it); it must gain states when that change lands.
